evidence: Cic. de Or. 2.140: quot hominēs, tot causae (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Verr. 2.2.14: reliquae tot et tantae et tam gravēs cīvitātēs (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Answered by quot: as many … as. With tantus of number and size together: tot et tantae.

terms.gloss: just as many, the same number
evidence: Caes. BG 1.48: equitum mīlia erant sex, totidem numerō peditēs (Lewis & Short)
Cic. Or. 53: quot ōrātiōnum genera esse dīximus, totidem ōrātōrum reperiuntur (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: tot mala sum passus, quot in aethere sīdera lūcent
phrases.english: I have borne as many troubles as there are stars shining in the sky

phrases.latin: equitum mīlia erant sex, totidem numerō peditēs
phrases.english: there were six thousand horsemen and the same number of foot soldiers

sources: Lewis & Short: tot · Lewis & Short: totidem
